Eleven functions and methods call `SpawnMeta::new_unnamed` directly. All of them are in the `tokio` crate. `tokio-util`, `tokio-stream`, `tokio-test` and `tokio-macros` don't call it.

I found these with a text search for `new_unnamed` across the repository, and the code index gave the same list. The search found 20 call sites, all inside the functions below; the only other match is the definition in `tokio/src/util/trace.rs`.
